args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the elevated error rate. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
